member.name: T:SixBench.Common.Streaming.AudioFrameHeader
member.summary: The 12-byte header that prefixes every audio packet on the stream socket.
member.remarks:
Layout (big-endian):
0..1 'V' 'A' magic 2 flags bit0 = mic/upstream, bit1 = discontinuity 3 reserved 0 4..7 sequence uint32 8..11 timestamp uint32 milliseconds since the session started
Video frames have no header; Annex-B data always begins with 00 00, so it never collides with the magic.
